cases.statement: One carrier: Pt. 43 (3-year-old boy) in an Indian multicentre SAID series.

quotes.quote: | CMC Vellore | Pt. 43 (3 y/M) | NA | Osteomyelitis/CGD | NA | NA | NA | • TNFAIP3

phenotype_specificity.statement: The only clinical entry is 'Osteomyelitis/CGD'. None of the A20 haploinsufficiency features the paper describes for patients 40 and 41 (oro-genital ulcers, colitis) are recorded for this boy. The paper does not say whether chronic granulomatous disease was confirmed or excluded, or whether other genes were tested.

quotes.quote: | CMC Vellore | Pt. 43 (3 y/M) | NA | Osteomyelitis/CGD | NA | NA | NA | • TNFAIP3
Molecular analysis in most patients at other centers was carried out at commercial laboratories that use targeted gene panel by Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) techniques.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense variant (p.(Gly603Arg)). The paper makes no mechanism statement about it.

authors_classification.statement: Stated in the Table 3 molecular-details cell.

concerns: The phenotype ('Osteomyelitis/CGD') does not match the disease as the paper describes it for its other TNFAIP3 carriers. The patient may have a different primary diagnosis (chronic granulomatous disease), and the paper does not say whether a CGD gene was tested.
Table row only. There is no case narrative, transcript, family history or follow-up ('NA').
notes_for_panel: The authors' own label for this variant is uncertain (quoted). The panel should weigh the phenotype mismatch. Family history is recorded as 'NA'.
